headline: Five levers against overcapacity
noFigure: No sourced figure yet: Req 5 owner to add

responses.title: Fleet management
responses.line: Defer or cancel newbuild slots, push deliveries back, lay up or hand back chartered ships.

responses.title: Network design
responses.line: Blank sailings, merged or shorter loops, fewer port calls: capacity leaves the lane without a ship being scrapped.

responses.title: Slow steaming
responses.line: Sail slower: each round trip takes more days, so the same fleet moves less cargo.

responses.title: Scrapping
responses.line: Recycle the oldest ships to shrink the fleet, but yard capacity, freight rates and rules limit the pace.

responses.title: Consolidation
responses.line: Mergers, alliances and vessel-sharing agreements: fewer players deciding capacity together.
